changelog:
v3.6.8 — Subtitles Fully Working + Input Fix

Subtitles
• Fixed: picking a subtitle track on the compatible-mode engine did nothing. The decoder couldn't identify the codec because of an internal demuxer option we used to work around a different issue. Reverted so subs decode normally. Flight-class edge cases are covered by the upcoming v3.7.0 architecture change.
• Fixed: pressing OK on a track in the Tracks panel sometimes did nothing on videos running through the compatible-mode engine. The control layer was swallowing the OK press before it reached the selected track. OK and D-pad now pass through cleanly when the Tracks panel is showing.

Diagnostics
• Subtitle pipeline now self-tests at playback start. Any structural break (missing caption surface, unattached view, etc.) is logged immediately in the debug log so future subtitle regressions surface automatically.
